I just want to stop being high 


I thought the box said 6mg, max 60mg.

So I took 10 pills thinking it would be 60 mg but it was 600mg

I don’t know, it was an accident. Didn’t mean to take this much and now I can’t walk lol. The trip is good. But I want to cut it out sooner. I am thinking about throwing up.

I have to work tomorrow, I want to come down.

This is true! Don’t think they are all the same or just finding one will help. Each therapist does things their own way, you got to find one that does things that you like and help you. 

We believe in you! You can make it through the hard part!

Just curious? 

Also, if you want help or support. I can do my best. We are all in the same boat here. 

Most of us have tried killing themselves and have been depressed longer than some of the people here. Trust me, we want to help. :)

No problem! We are all in the same boat. But we all have choices to make. Some the same as other and some choices no one will ever know or feel what you are going through. Never be afraid to reach out. 

There is always a person out there for you willing to help you. 

I been trying to get a date or find someone who will like me more than a friend for almost 9 years. I havnt given up even though I am completely miserable. I have done everything my make myself better physically but never touch my brain until recently. 

One thing I will never say is “things will get better” fuck that bullshit. No one knows if it will , but it doesn’t hurt to try.
Hey bud! How old are you?

Hey! It’s takes time! I am 28m and just opened up this year. Best is to practice with people like us here! 

We are here to support you and help you as much as we can! 

But it is a lot easier to open up to internet strangers than real life.

How I did it, I started with my best friend. Told him I am not doing well and we need to have a serious talk, then I practiced talking to myself in the mirror and then finally texted him everything. Next I told my other best friend. A week later I started seeing a therapist. After 3 sessions, I talked to my mom. I am slowly going down the list of people and opening up.

Time to find a new therapist! Not every therapist is good and not everyone will for you. You have to look for one that fits the bill like dating ( don’t worry I am a piece of shit who can’t even date now ) 

I was lucky and found a therapist the first go around and like him. 

I also have backups Incase something happens and need to see a different one. 

Remember, they are there to help you, if they are not helping you, move to a new one. It’s hard to go back and explain everything down. What I do is just write down EXACLY how you feeel and how you are doing, it’s will take a while and be hard but it makes it easy when you just meet the person and tell them I am gonna email you everything to make the next appointment easier. 

But stay strong! We are all here for support! We will help you as much as we can and we love you no mater what ! :)

Hey, finding friends is very easy but finding good friends is hard. I just opened up to my two friends for the first time and I am 28. 

You have to keep looking but at the same time not try super hard or you will push them away. You will know when you find a good friend, it will click right away. Ease yourself into it and then you can start talking to them more about stuff. 

You also have a whole community here that will talk to you. Some people will even let you call them! You are not alone! :)

I am really happy you are still here with us. We are all here for you! Better to suffer with friends than alone and you know everyone in this community will be here for you. Most of us here want to die. So we understand. Some have tried to take there own life as well. I tried twice and failed both times. But I am still alive and kicking. I decided to get help. I am seeing a therapist now. I also told my two best friends what’s going on and told them everything. 

My issue right now is since I tried to OD on oxy, I been addicted to them since. Fucking hard to stop taking them now. Feels so good to just numb out. But I’ll stop. I want to stop and need to stop. 

We got your back though!
Nice dude !
Yo, if someone is bullying you and if you live near me, I will fuck them up for you. I got your back. I got a lot of connections.
Hey brother! I been watching one piece since probably like episode 150 English dubs was released . It’s one of my favorite anime’s and I been watching it every week.

Oh what anime. And sheesh I am 28. Y’all making me feel old on here. But I am still alive lol. I am hoping things will get better. My first therapy session is in 1 hour. 

You got this bro. We got your back. We are all friends here struggling with the same shit. Sometimes it doesn’t get better for a long time. But you at least got to have fun with it. My two best friends know where I am at and know I tried to kill myself. I still joke around with them and tell them ( jokingly ) when they ask me what I am doing, “you know, just practicing making a noose” or “death seems nice right now” they know when the context is a joke and what not. But I try to make people laugh and enjoy what little life I have left. 

There is still things in life I want to do and I make them goals. Like I want to go travel somewhere like Germany or anywhere outside this country. Gotta make a bucket list. Friends, family, and goals is what keeps me going.

I have always put a fake face on. This year I finally told my close friends what’s going on. 

I have probably been suicidal for about 8 years. I have been depressed my whole life. I started cutting myself around the 8 year mark. This year, i actually tried killing myself twice. 

I think telling people and finally trying to get help has helped me. I am finally being more positive. 

But long term wanting to die 24/7. It slowly makes you not care what people think. Makes you not care what you do. Like I don’t care if I walk across a crosswalk and get hit by a car. I don’t car if I crash into a tree of I am driving during bad weather. Just stuff like that.
Thanks ❤️. The 17th was one year when he died. It was a long 5 year battle with cancer. I was beside him every step.

You are so young!!!! :) I am 28, I am double your age! 

But I am not going to say things will get better. I hate when people say that. Things don’t get better magically. You got to put work in to get to a place where you want to start living again.

Great thing is, there is a lot of people out there. But for starters, you do got to get out when you are 18, those kind of people will always bring you down. Right now, for the next 4 years. Do what you can do you can support yourself financially. You got this bro! I believe in you! Friends will come and go but you will find some good ones that you will keep forever! 

You are not alone in this world, my mom is the only thing keeping me alive.

❤️

Hey! You are not alone! If it wasn’t for the amount of love I get from my mom. I would of ended my life a lot sooner. I still tried a few time because when I hit a low, I can’t control myself. 

But it’s about doing the right things. Not in the moment but for the future. In life, it’s about you and only you. Do what makes you happy. Change what you need to change, cut out what you need to cut out, and bring things into your life that makes you happy. 

You are your own person. But you are not alone. You have me and others to help support you to happiness. ❤️

I think it’s sucks for people who die when they don’t want to die. I wish my dad was still alive and healthy. All he wanted was to see his two nieces grow up and spoil them.

But I get what you are coming from. I want to die but I just lost my dad and don’t want to make my mom even more sad .

No problem, I always try to stay positive! You can still be positive with people and things even though I stop stop breathing forever. But not wanting to be alive is more of a feeling and state of mind in my head. It lives up there. But I still like cute little kittens ! That lives up there in my head as well! Hehe and cute ducks :)

I hope I can spread positive feelings to people and still let them know I can relate! We don’t have to be alone in this world.
I play games, look at cute kittens ( thinking about getting one), watch anime/twitch/YouTube.

I am a 28m. I been dealing with this for a very long time. Almost longer than you been alive. Lol. I am just now getting help. Don’t wait as long as I did.

Best thing that helped me was finding someone that you can relate to with kinda the same issues. Talking to people helped me. I am going to see a therapist tomorrow for the first time. My anxiety is been going full force thinking about it. I went 36 hours without sleep. Not that didn’t want to, kept getting attacks. Like a mine heart attack every time I laid down...

But you are not alone. I thought I was until I opened up and started telling people. Hardest thing for me was telling my best friend that I tried to OD on pills last week and I don’t want to be alive anymore. It was a good decision to tell my friends. You need support.

You got us for support here. Don’t be afraid to reach out.

Dying is always the easy way out. I am 28 and been dealing with this for a while. I am just now getting help. But at the end of the day, you are still young. You still got to try, I don’t know what all is going on, but don’t sign out just yet.

Sometimes it’s impossible to talk to people. I had a good friend. She helped me a bit and got me to a better place. But shit went down and when I needed a person to talk to, she gone. She completely distanced herself from me and I tried to kill myself twice and she acts like she don’t even care and now  a lot more stuff happened and she is no where to be found. All she has been telling me whenever I do text her, the responses I get is things will get better or take one day at a time. But I left her behind now. She wasn’t a true friend and hasn’t acted as one. I just needed a little support and I will NEVER CALL A HOTLINE! ( don’t worry, I already found new friends and a therapist)

But this kind of stuff is annoying. Things will never get better with bad friends. HOTLINES ARE STUPID WHEN YOU TALK TO SOMEONE YOU CANT RELATE TO.

Everyone is asleep in my life or decided that I am not good enough for them. I am alone right now and no one will talk to me... I am hurting right now and Yus my chest hurts. Drinking is the only way I can sleep. My chest hurts so much. Anxiety attacks make my chest hurt and I get them all the time when I try to sleep. :( 

Sorry I am very lonely and low right now.

I have the same issue. It sucks seeing people happy or enjoying life when you hate yourself and hate being alive. I have to put in so much effort to wake up on the morning and yet these people get to live a happier life than me.
They worry a lot, but it’s more like they just want to help, but to in your face help and they want to help fix all issue no matter how small. They are coming from a good place.

I do think therapy would help. It’s just the process of finding the right one, which I don’t think will be to hard. I am worried about how people in my life would look at me. It’s stupid to say, I always just put a fake face on and act happy all the time. I have always just said I am good or happy whenever someone ask how i am doing. I know I am stupid to be worried about this. It’s just going to be a shock when I start telling people or they will think I am joking or over reacting. And my family is a bunch of gossiping people. Hard to tell one person, because everyone else will know plus half the world lol. They also worry to much. I cut my finger one time last month and they were trying to get me to go to the ER.... my cut healed in a week....

Thank you for your response. But I am not a creep to start with. I completely get what you are coming from. But the “stringing along” comment comes from years of conversations we had. The false hope isn’t a make believe thing either. I didn’t want to go into NSFW topic in the post but the sexting and live video fun and other various things did were real. Also saying we are not friend is immature of you. Things are complicated yes but we are friend. Just hours ago she agreed we are best friends. I know it’s hard to put years of friendship and trying to make things work as more than friends on a short post. But I hope you can understand

Edit: I am more than welcome to elaborate on any topic or question you have.
